description.en: Eoraptor lunensis has a light bipedal body, compact low skull, grasping forelimbs and long balancing tail. Skin, colour, posture and dimensions are artistic estimates; historical museum classifications and diet labels are not treated as settled conclusions.
description.zh: 始盗龙 Eoraptor lunensis 具有轻巧的双足身体、紧凑低矮的头骨、抓握前肢和长平衡尾。皮肤、颜色、姿态及尺寸为艺术估计；不把旧博物馆资料的分类与食性标签视为已定结论。

construction_notes: Simple skin envelope over reference bones. Fingers can be low-poly tapered jointed geometry; no texture-defined false claws.
Short head is relative proportion in the original inventory combination, not a circular baby-dinosaur face. Avoid gratuitous spikes, crests or copied ornament.
Muted earthy color and closed or slightly open mouth are artistic choices. Original anatomical combination is the gray gate; no extra bespoke pose or image requirement.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic small-bodied envelope, not measured holotype; NHM general profile lists 1.7m, which is contextual rather than a modeling constraint.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block light early-dinosaur body with short head and grasping forelimbs with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织轻巧的早期恐龙体型、短头与抓握前肢；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: light early-dinosaur body with short head and grasping forelimbs. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：轻巧的早期恐龙体型、短头与抓握前肢。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

scientific_limits.en: Skin, color, soft tissue thickness, posture and dimensions are artistic estimates. Exhibit mounts/casts may contain reconstructed elements. Older museum pages use historical theropod labels; do not present that classification or diet as a resolved modern phylogenetic claim.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Eoraptor lunensis living reconstruction informed by named museum skeletal mounts and the University of Texas holotype-skull record. Not a specimen scan or exact mounted skeleton copy.
shape_requirements: Original combination: light early-dinosaur body, relatively short head and grasping forelimbs. Do not make a scaled Herrerasaurus or an elongated Coelophysis head/neck.
Slender bipedal trunk, long balancing tail and folded mobile forelimbs with separated grasping digits. Main claw-bearing fingers must read; do not replace hand with two-digit tyrannosaur mitten.
Relatively compact low skull with tapered muzzle and visible eye region, not a deep massive carnivore head. Preserve head-to-body balance before teeth details.
Maintain open elbow/torso and leg negative spaces, digitigrade rear feet and restrained horizontal balance; not upright kangaroo stance.
frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Eoraptor lunensis; holotype skull reference identified by UT DigiMorph, plus Belgian and Joggins display casts/mounts as visual morphology references
